definition: אֵלֶּה demonstrative pronoun plural these (Nabataean אלה ( Lzb 264 Cooke 241 ), Cappadocian and Egyptian Aramaic אלה ( Lzb Eph. i. 323 RÉS 361 A 3 S-C Pap. E.13, Ki 13 ): probably therefore not, as used to be supposed, a Hebraism, but a peculiarity of the dialects of Jer 10:11 and of Ezra (in which the usually Aramaic form אִלֵּין does not occur) : see further אִלֵּין ); — these , Jer 10:11 ; Ezra 5:15 Kt .
